SELECT t_system_config.id, t_system_config.config_name AS configName, t_system_config.config_key AS configKey, t_system_config.config_value AS configValue, t_system_config.config_type AS configType FROM t_system_config WHERE t_system_config.is_deleted = #{param.deleted}
AND t_system_config.config_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.configName}, '%')
AND t_system_config.config_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.configKey}, '%')
AND t_system_config.config_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.configValue}, '%')
AND t_system_config.config_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.configType}, '%')
ORDER BY t_system_config.gmt_modified ASC
